target: net R > 0 (binary); the ridge-netR configuration predicts net R itself
rows: train pool, not flagged (clock-shifted week, before 2020), filled trades, every needed timeframe present

gbt.what: C0, the reference: gradient-boosted trees (depth 2, 120 trees) on 70 inputs

logit-short.what: C1: logistic regression, L2 (C 0.1), the 7 short-list inputs

mono-gbt.what: C2: boosted stumps (depth 1, 60 trees) on the short list, non-decreasing in the policy's five factors

pooled-logit.what: C3: one logistic regression (C 0.1) over all seven edges, the short list plus one intercept per edge

ridge-netR.what: C4: ridge regression of net R (alpha 100), the short list; its output is an expected R, never a probability

notInputs.eventNear: null before 2022 (no calendar): its missingness would mark the era
notInputs.regime: equals regimeBase except for the event override, which exists only from 2022

verdictRule: A scorer passes only if, out of fold, all five lines hold: (1) the trades it keeps beat the trades it skips with a Welch t of at least 2.0 and a one-sided p, Holm-corrected over every scorer x edge test of the run, of at most 0.02275 (the threshold is chosen on earlier, closed trades only; a pooled scorer is tested on net R with each edge's training mean removed); (2) the kept trades average more than all trades; (3) their maximum drawdown is not deeper than taking every setup's; (4) the Brier score is no worse than the prior rate's (for the net-R regression: mean squared error no worse than the training mean); (5) the last test block agrees. Otherwise: rejected challenger. A scorer that passes is marked 'passed validation, not promoted: owner decision'.
promotion: manual, by the owner, through the API (model.register then model.promote). Nothing here promotes a model.
examPolicy: This trainer cannot read the exam pool: the loader drops every row that is not in the train pool (733 rows) before unpacking it. The first trainer's two runs read exam-pool aggregates; that record is ml/archive/gbt-1 and is not repeated.
